annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BNB AutoChain with promised daily returns of 2% to 2.30% for 70 to 100 days and directs viewers to a WhatsApp group to participate. The speaker describes funding a local wallet and urges viewers to start, while the displayed project page shows a Deposit control and invested-balance fields. Warnings to invest only what one can afford and acknowledgment of a possible scam-based system accompany, rather than replace, the participation guidance.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted smart-contract investment links a stated minimum capital participation to advertised daily returns; the speaker also describes recovering capital and using profit to generate more money in the system. The supplied inputs do not verify the returns.
